verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I will abide in You
So come abide in me
For without You I can do nothing
For without You I can do nothing

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
To walk in the cool of the day with You
To gaze on the beauty of all You do
To meditate on Your glorious splendor
I was made for You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
On You I meditate
And pray both night and day
O Lord, that I could be with You where You are
O Lord, that I could be with You where You are

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
To be called a lover of God
To speak face to face
To know all Your thoughts
To abide in Your love, Your love in me
To keep Your commands
That I may be filled with joy
